name: sdd
description: Spec-driven development on Azure DevOps work items: spec and bug flows, ADO spec mirror, impact analysis, visual pages and the question guard.

openAtStart.title: Open the sdd view when a Desktop session starts
openAtStart.description: On: the sdd view opens beside the chat at the start of every Claude Desktop session in an sdd workspace, as a start page when no work item is open. Off: open it from the band or with /sdd-view.
